settings.keywords: Manamoondi first floor, full interior fit-out: 3 bedrooms + 3 attached toilets furnished, vitrified and anti-skid tile fields set out from centre, cove false ceilings, layered 3000 K lighting in switchable groups, curtains, upholstered headboard walls, styling, electrical and MEP, render-look, west afternoon sun, exterior context and 8 cameras

source.brief: warm contemporary — light oak, ivory, brass; 3000 K throughout; cove ceilings in habitable rooms

settings.renderNote: Bake with bake_plan.mjs, render with render_plan.py. Ceiling heights come from wall-with-math: slab 3, band soffit 2.620, panel soffit 2.770. Light groups: downlights, cove, pendants, mirror, outdoor, daylight.
